focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需加速碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入实质性征收阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期最终报告，强调进口商须确保嵌入式碳排放数据可核查。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业面临碳成本传导压力，建议尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，完善供应商数据链条，并关注欧盟认可的核查机构名单，以降低未来合规成本。
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime starting in 2027. The European Commission's final transitional report stresses that importers must ensure verifiable embedded emissions data. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, and fertilisers face carbon cost pass-through pressure. Companies should establish product-level carbon footprint accounting, strengthen supplier data chains, and monitor EU-accredited verifier lists to reduce future compliance costs.

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭裁定：跨境电商业者未履行数据本地化义务不构成合同根本违约
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭近期审结一起跨境电商服务合同纠纷，明确数据本地化监管要求不当然构成合同目的落空。案中中国电商平台因未满足印尼数据存储规定被当地处罚，其新加坡服务商主张免责。法院认为，平台作为数据控制者应自行承担合规风险，服务商仅提供技术支持不构成根本违约。该案提示出海企业应在合同中明确合规责任分配与免责条款，避免因监管变化引发争议。
case.source: 来源：新加坡上诉庭判例摘要 · 2026.11
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court: Cross-border E-commerce Operator's Failure to Meet Data Localisation Rules Not a Fundamental Breach
case.summary_en: The Singapore Appellate Court recently ruled in a cross-border e-commerce service contract dispute that data localisation requirements do not automatically frustrate contractual purpose. A Chinese e-commerce platform penalised in Indonesia for non-compliance with local data storage rules sought to hold its Singapore service provider liable. The court held that the platform, as data controller, bears compliance risk, and the provider's technical support did not constitute fundamental breach. The case highlights the need for clear compliance allocation and exemption clauses in contracts.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Appellate Court judgment summary · Nov 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，港澳企业可申请数据出境安全评估绿色通道
policy.summary: 国家网信办与广东省近期联合发布粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施，允许符合条件的港澳企业通过绿色通道申请数据出境安全评估，缩短审批时限。新规明确在医疗、金融、跨境电商等领域开展试点，要求企业建立数据分类分级保护制度。建议大湾区港资、澳资企业尽快梳理数据资产，完成自评估并准备申请材料，以利用政策红利降低合规成本。
policy.source: 来源：国家互联网信息办公室、广东省人民政府 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: New GBA Cross-border Data Flow Rules: HK/Macao Firms Eligible for Green Channel for Data Export Security Assessment
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China and Guangdong Province have jointly issued facilitation measures for cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area, allowing eligible Hong Kong and Macao enterprises to apply for data export security assessments via a green channel with shortened approval timelines. Pilots cover healthcare, finance, and cross-border e-commerce, requiring data classification and grading systems. GBA-based HK/Macao firms should map data assets, complete self-assessments, and prepare applications to benefit from the policy.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of China; Guangdong Provincial People's Government · Nov 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华投资限制新规扩围，企业应重构跨境交易架构与合规防火墙
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期拟将半导体、人工智能等领域对华投资限制扩展至更多敏感技术，并强化对通过第三地间接投资的审查。出海企业应重新评估现有跨境交易架构，避免通过新加坡、开曼等中间层规避监管；在投资协议中增设监管变化退出机制；同时建立技术出口分类台账，对涉及受限技术的合作开展内部合规审查。建议企业提前与专业律师团队进行压力测试，确保交易可进可退。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球·iGlobal Law 编辑部 · 2026.11.25
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Expanded US Outbound Investment Restrictions on China Require Rebuilding Cross-border Deal Structures and Compliance Firewalls
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US is set to expand outbound investment restrictions on China in semiconductors, AI, and other sensitive technologies, and to tighten scrutiny of indirect investments via third countries. Chinese companies going global should reassess existing cross-border structures to avoid using Singapore or Cayman intermediaries to circumvent rules; incorporate regulatory-change exit mechanisms in investment agreements; and maintain technology export classification ledgers with internal compliance reviews for restricted-tech cooperation. Early stress-testing with legal counsel is advised to keep deals flexible.
